labels.text: 2023 Nigerian general election: Bola Tinubu is elected as Nigeria's president, defeating former vice president Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi.
At least 106 people are killed when a wedding boat capsizes on the Niger River in Kwara State, Nigeria.
2024 Borno State bombings: 30 people are killed and 100 are injured when three separate bomb blasts occur in the town of Gwoza in Borno State, Nigeria.
98 people are killed in a fuel tanker explosion near Suleja, Niger State, Nigeria.
2025 Nigeria floods: More than 500 people are killed, and hundreds more missing after flooding in Mokwa.

The United States, in cooperation with the Nigerian government, initiates a series of airstrikes targeting Islamic State-affiliated militants operating in the country's Sokoto State. US President Donald Trump states that rising extremist violence against Christians is a primary reason for the strikes.
Boko Haram insurgency: Boko Haram attacks two villages in Kwara State, Nigeria, killing at least 162 people.
